chapter: Europe and the Black and Blue years
title: Dr. and Madame Chavron: her favourite family in France
summary: The Chavrons of Orange, France, kept open house for musicians with food, a pool, records and film clips. They paid her hotel bills and she regards the family as home. She was upset to hear Madame Chavron had died.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
